import java.util.*;
import java.math.BigInteger;

public class Main {
    static Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);

    static long factorial(int n) {
        BigInteger res = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            res = res.multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(i));
        }
        return res.longValue();
    }

    static long A(int n, int k) {
        return factorial(n) / factorial(n - k);
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int mod = sc.nextInt();

        if (n == 1) {
            System.out.println(0);
            return;
        }

        List<Long> z = new ArrayList<>();
        z.add(1L);
        long aaa = 0;

        for (int i = 2; i <= n; i++) {
            int sizeNz = ((i - 1) * i) / 2 + 1;
            List<Long> nz = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(sizeNz, 0L));
            List<Long> d = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(z.size() + 1, 0L));

            for (int w = z.size() - 1; w >= 0; w--) {
                d.set(w, (d.get(w + 1) + z.get(w)) % mod);
            }

            for (int w = 0; w < sizeNz; w++) {
                int L = Math.max(0, w + 1 - i);
                int R = Math.min(z.size() - 1, w);
                long val = d.get(L) - d.get(R + 1);
                nz.set(w, ((val % mod) + mod) % mod);
            }

            List<Long> e = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d.size() + 1, 0L));
            List<Long> f = new ArrayList<>(Collections.nCopies(d.size() + 1, 0L));

            for (int w = 0; w < d.size(); w++) {
                e.set(w + 1, (e.get(w) + d.get(w)) % mod);
                f.set(w + 1, (f.get(w) - w * d.get(w)) % mod);
            }

            int R = z.size();
            long bbb = 0;

            for (int jj = Math.max(0, z.size() - i); jj < z.size() - 1; jj++) {
                int L = jj + 2;
                long term = ((e.get(R) - e.get(L) + mod) % mod) * (i + 1 + jj) % mod
                        + ((f.get(R) - f.get(L) + mod) % mod);
                term %= mod;
                bbb = (bbb + term * z.get(jj)) % mod;
            }

            for (int jj = 0; jj <= z.size() - i - 1; jj++) {
                int L = jj + 2;
                int R2 = i + jj;
                long term = ((e.get(R2 + 1) - e.get(L) + mod) % mod) * (i + 1 + jj) % mod
                        + ((f.get(R2 + 1) - f.get(L) + mod) % mod);
                term %= mod;
                bbb = (bbb + term * z.get(jj)) % mod;
            }

            aaa = (aaa + (bbb * A(n, n - i)) % mod) % mod;
            z = nz;
        }

        System.out.println(aaa % mod);
    }
}
